Standing in the sterile concrete room of your unfinished basement, which has been fitted out more like a makeshift laboratory, the two of you look towards an antique wooden table your grandmother handed down to your mom before passing away. And without a second thought, your mom gave it to you when you moved into your townhouse on the Square. She was happy to let you and Matt use the table so it'd be more useful than collecting dust, but it's not the table that grabs the attention of either of you. <div id="story-dialogue"> /* This text updates automatically when they click Confirm above! */ <<Matt>> "Well we didn't do all of this just to stare, come on let's try it out $playerName!" <</Matt>> </div> Sitting on the center of the table, over messy layers of barely legible scribblings you prefer to call notes and blueprints, rests the device. The device you've spent nearly your whole life focused on. And for the first time ever, it glows. A vibrant electric blue color pulses in synchronization with the ever increasing pace of your heartbeat. <<me>> "Matt! I think I've finally done it!" <</me>> Your excitement starts to take over. <<me>> "<i>We've</i> finally done it!" <</me>> You correct yourself, sharing this moment with your friend. <<Matt>> "Let's Go!" <</Matt>> Truthfully Matt was more a cheerleader than a helping hand on this lifelong endeavor, but he did always inspire you to continue your work when you felt like giving up. You are the one who literally put your blood, sweat, and tears into the project. Peculiarly, it was after mixing your blood into the fluid chamber that the device began to glow. And the way the color ominously hums in tune with your heart beating is something only you seem to truly experience in this moment. The intensity of it all fills you with a mix of competing emotions. <<Matt>> "$She actually did it." <</Matt>> Matt mutters under his breath. After a bit of decompression from all the thoughts flying through your head, you finally concede to lift your hand up, reaching towards the table. Your perspiring shaky hands feel the cold contrast of ceramic as you extend your grasp. <<Matt>> "Don't think your coffee is going to fill itself back up, unless you thought of a way to do that too?" <</Matt>> <<me>> "A test object." <</me>> Placing the coffee mug on the empty floor, you return to the table once more and reach for the pulsating anomaly that has been holding Matt's undivided attention. The matte black handle holds lukewarm as you finally touch the device, a pulsating blue light fills the air and the energy vibrates throughout your body as you now aim your new time displacement device, which your working notes coined as a "Phase Gun" towards the coffee mug. <div class="reality-glitch"> ZAP ZAP </div> A half domed bubble shield about 6 feet in every direction encircles the coffee mug. The light of the bubble quickly grows bright, and then nothing. You and Matt both stare at the empty floor, the coffee mug vanished into thin air. <<Matt>> "Woah!" <</Matt>> <<me>> "It actually worked!!" <</me>> <<Matt>> "So where did it go?" <</Matt>> Matt's astonished. He always believed in you, but he's spent countless summers and days with you on this project, and he's paused in disbelief at what just transpired. <<me>> "Only one way to find out. Are you ready?" <</me>> <<Matt>> "Ready for wha---" <</Matt>> Before Matt can finish his sentence you move the dial on the Phase Gun and point it at the ground equidistance from Matt and yourself.. In your apartment's communal basement, the space feels entirely different, but before you have time to process too much, Matt butts in dramatically. <<Matt>> "Dude!! Your hair!" <</Matt>> You're not quite sure what he means, but looking at Matt you see he has gone completely bald! Could that mean.. You brush the top of your head, and sure enough, not a spec of hair in sight, your beard is gone too, and as you look down at yourself for any damages, your forearms look as if they had gone through a professional laser hair removal surgery. Every hair follicle seems to have burned straight off after powering on the device, but nothing else seems different at least, that is until you focus your attention back up. <<me>> "Whoa... it actually worked." <</me>> <<Matt>> "Yeah, you sure showed that coffee cup and our hair. In place of your apartment's familiar storage lockers and exposed pipes, sleek metallic paneling lines the walls, lit by smooth, recessed strips of cool white light. And the utility units! Instead of the old washer-dryer setups, there are humming, automated capsule pods and crystalline recycling units you can't quite identify. <<Matt>> "Okay, okay." <</Matt>> Matt shuffles in a back and forth pace that you can't quite pin whether it stems from anxiety or excitement. <<Matt>> "You're telling me we've actually teleported, into a new time?" <</Matt>> You take a look back at the Phase Gun, surprisingly for the first time since the jump <<me>> "Assuming its accurate, yes, we should be in 2126." <</me>> <<Matt>> "This is mind bending, what do you think happened to our apartment?" <</Matt>> You draw your vision looking up towards the staircase. Surely there's more fun things to do after jumping a century forward in time, but you would be lying to yourself to say that Matt's comment wasn't also sparking your curiosity. <<me>> "Only one way to find out, but I doubt we'll be running into anyone we know, so be careful." <</me>> The two of you break down to a whisper. and make your way to the stairs. I was all by myself in this.. void." <</me>> You continue. <<Matt>> "Really?" <</Matt>> <<me>> "Yeah really, I was all by myself, and this voice said it was waiting for me. In fact it said 'we were waiting for you'. It told me a change must be made, not like a request or a threat.. more like.. a statement of fact, with no room for debate. I still don't know what it meant, or what it was though." <</me>> <<Matt>> "Wow. I really think you should take a minute to yourself $playerName. Even I can see you've changed. Matt leads the way back to your apartment, as you make your way inside, he splits off to the kitchen while you opt for some alone time in the bathroom. <<link "Bathroom">><<set $previousPassage to "Second Jump">><<goto "Bathroom">><</link>><<set $layer9_shoes to "images/Shoes-01-Masc-Sneakers-Default.png">>\ <<addHygiene "-1">>\ <<nobr>> <div class="image-container"> <img src="images/1926-Master-Bedroom.png" class="story-image" alt="1926 Master Bedroom"> </div> <</nobr>>\ Blue lights fade and the world around you changes after your second jump through time. What was just a minute ago your entire apartment, has reappeared in front of you as a master bedroom. The furniture is antique, though decadent and appearing newly crafted. Gold embellishments line the bedsheets, a formal dress hangs on the wall amongst many paintings. <<Matt>> "Have we really fallen so far as a society, that our entire apartment used to just be someone's bedroom? I could get used to the past." <</Matt>> Matt states with a wide smile as he begins taking a peek around. You take a minute to inspect yourself, noting you still look the same as you did before the jump. No visible changes to your clothes or body or anything else as far as you can tell. So you join Matt looking around the bedroom too after a quick look at the powered down phase gun you return to your bag. <<me>> "So we should be in 1926 now." <</me>> <<Matt>> "Wild" <</Matt>> You notice a dresser next to the bed with a name engraved into a golden plaque "Julie". <<me>> "Look a small clue, must be Julie's room." <</me>> Matt's on the other side of the bed, <<Matt>> "There's a name on this side too. 'Gay-no'. 'Gah-no' I'm not sure how to pronounce it. It's spelled G-A-N-O." <</Matt>> <<me>> "Pretty sure that's pronounced 'Guh-no'" <</me>> You respond. <<me>> "We must be in one of those wealthy mansions before the building was split up into seperate apartments after the World Wars. I bet these two own our whole building!" <</me>> <<Matt>> "You got to be kidding me! Probably pay less rent too." <</Matt>> You laugh in response. <<me>> "Not so sure about that." <</me>> As you're busy with your inspection, you hear some shuffling and footsteps beating against the staircase, coming your way. Before you have any time to react, the door peeks open to reveal an older man, dressed in a suit and holding a glass of Whiskey. <<Gano>> "$playerName? Matthew? How?" <</Gano>> The man stands in disbelief, but none moreso than you both do in response. He already knows your names? And he's the one asking 'how?' <<me>> "Uh hello." <</me>> You shuffle away from the dressers closer to the man at the door. <<Gano>> "Pardon my disbelief, I can't pretend to understand that device of yours, but how is it that you have appeared in our room immediately after we said our farewells downstairs?" <</Gano>> The man asks politely, almost too relaxed after seeing strangers rummaging through his bedroom. <<Matt>> "This is getting really weird." <</Matt>> Matt says under his breath. He already knows about the device?! And what does he <i>mean</i> you were just downstairs?? You've only just arrived! You can piece two and two together to guess that this is the same man with his name on the nearby dresser, so if you can figure out anything that's going on, you may as well start there. <<me>> "Gano, right?" <</me>> Your inquistiveness only adds to his confusion. <<Gano>> "Yes, of course. I suppose I failed to consider <i>for you</i> it may have been long since we've last met. Please forgive me." <</Gano>> He says in earnest. <<if $layer13_accessories1 and $layer13_accessories1.includes("Wig")>>\ <<Gano>> "It's nice to see you both sporting a full head of hair now, though perhaps in need of a cut?" <</Gano>>\ <<elseif $layer13_accessories1 eq "images/Blank.png">>\ <<Gano>> "I don't presume you have already lost the hat?" <</Gano>>\ <</if>> <<Matt>> "I guess so." <</Matt>> Matt answers with an air of confusion. Gano sure seems to know much more about you than you do him, but to your benefit, he's treating you much more like an age old friend than a complete stranger. <<Gano>> "Come now, Julie was just about to prepare dinner, I'm sure we can fix you something up too and talk more over a warm supper." <</Gano>> Gano gestures his arm, inviting you outside the door. The girls both appear to be your same age, give or take. Your apartment has transitioned from a spacey blue aesthetic to a hard hitting pink and white dreamscape, with subtle futuristic flairs of curved edges on various furniture pieces. But it's still noticeably the same apartment as you call home in your time. The girl with the pink highlights lets out a small laugh. <<Zoey>> "Yes, hello Matt. Quick to resync." <</Zoey>> She takes the pillow out of Claire's hands and throws it towards Matt. <<Zoey>> "You nearly scared Claire half to death you guntz!" <</Zoey>> The banter is quickly turned playful, but how in the world does she know Matt's name? <<Zoey>> "Maybe you want to tell me how you beamed into my living room $playerName?" <</Zoey>> The girl asks with an inquisitive ascending voice. Zoey's right that it spooks you out, but right now, this whole experience with two girls sitting not even five feet away talking about some past experience with you that <i>you</i> never shared is really getting under your skin. <<Matt>> "Okay this is getting weird." <</Matt>> Matt mutters under his breath. <<Zoey>> "Oh the two of you. You can still appear masculine again by dressing up, but you will no longer be accepted by others for doing so.) Charm stat will affect recruting companions. Meet Two Male companions early game. As you reach the transition your charm takes a hit from your base charm dropping from 4 to 0 and style blocks begin to only reward you for leaning towards a feminine style, creating friction on the resitance path, and helping shape the momentum of the acceptance path. Your male companions will start to respond to your charm "I don't man, seems like that time machine is having a real impact on you, I think I'll pass" Which can introduce us to our new female companions Zoey (future era) and Jane (Past Era) will aid in the feminization journey [[Divergence]] Simple note, not part of the game. Greenwich Village, NYC setting Minetta Lane The player steps out of the alley into 1926, walks past a seemingly normal storefront on Bleecker Street, notices suspicious crates being hauled down into a cellar, and follows the trail right into Tommy's turf—with Jane's jazz music echoing from the floor above! Past Era 1926 Male Companion Tommy (Speakeasy Bootlegger) Female Companion Jane (Flapper) Matt is your first companion automatically grouped in the players party as your loyal friend and assitant in the great time machine experiment that begins by introducing the phase gun. He will largely stick with you through thick/thin, being an anchor of the story that most relates to your adventures / mishaps of the story. 1. The 1926 Past Era Companion Archetype: The Speakeasy Bootlegger / Roaring '20s Hustler Name Ideas: Tommy, Frankie, or Jack Fashion Style: High-waisted trousers, newsboy cap/fedora, suspenders, rolled sleeves (Classic 1920s workwear). First Meeting (Charm locked at 4): You meet him in a dimly lit alley or backroom speakeasy. He’s sharp, street-smart, and cautious. Since your Charm is at base 4, he brushes you off as just another average guy not worth taking on a dangerous job. Revisit (Style blocks active, light physical changes): His Reaction: "Hey, you look a little slimmer, pal—working hard or hardly working?" The Recruitment: Stacking Blue style blocks pushes your Charm high enough that he respects your swagger and agrees to join your crew as your heavy/guide in the 1920s. Post-Transition Reaction: Once you cross into the Neutral/Transition state, 1926 chivalry and gender roles kick in. He gets deeply weirded out trying to treat someone he thought was his "pal" like a dame, eventually opting out because the "time contraption" is getting too unhinged. 2. The 2126 Future Era Companion Archetype: The Chrome-Mechanic / Tech-Runner Name Ideas: Kael, Dax, or Vane Fashion Style: Utility vests, LED-accented jackets, rugged cyberware aesthetics. First Meeting (Charm locked at 4): You meet him in a high-tech workshop or neon synth-bar. He’s cynical and hyper-focused on efficiency. At base 4 Charm, he considers you an uninteresting tourist who can't handle futuristic tech. Revisit (Style blocks active, light physical changes): His Reaction: "Biometrics look a bit lighter than last time... lost some density?" The Recruitment: Your elevated Blue style Charm proves you’ve got high social currency and presence, convincing him to lend his futuristic tech expertise to your party. Post-Transition Reaction: As your physical compliance ramps up and masculine Charm drops, his pragmatism takes over. He notices the dramatic bio-readout shifts and decides the temporal radiation is mutating you into something he didn't sign up to navigate. Location Name What it was in 1926 How to use it in your passage Washington Square Park The central open plaza surrounded by NYU brick buildings and high-society townhouses. Perfect landing spot to showcase the temporal shift (automobiles, 1920s fashion). MacDougal Street Packed with underground speakeasies, bohemian tea rooms, and jazz dens. The street where you locate the hidden entrance to Tommy’s speakeasy. Minetta Lane A narrow, winding side alley known for low-lit, hidden back-door entrances. Where Tommy unloads smuggled liquor crates from delivery trucks late at night. Bleecker Street Commercial strip with tailors, bakeries, and newsstands. A working Wardrobe system for the Paperdoll Fully functioning in-game music player Fully fleshed out coding framework with hidden systems that will be explored further in the coming Chapters" <</texter>>\ <<texter "ToT Mobile">> Version 1.0.1 Bug Fix "Reworked Point Badge system under Paperdoll and above gender presentation slider Fixed Missing Image Path on paperdoll that put a question mark above the body and under the clothing layers.." <</texter>> <<texter "ToT Mobile">> Patch Notes V(1.1.0) <br> <br> + Chapter 1 Release <br> • The Story continues in Chapter 1. A new skip chapter feature will also allow you to skip the prologue if you’ve already played before <br> <br> + Shops and Fast Travel System <br> • The Story will introduce players to new shopping locations and the new Map inside the Bag Inventory will allow you to pause from the story at any time to enter a freeroam loop to go shopping or use the wardrobe and safely save your place in the story  <br> • The Bag inventory has been outfitted with new buttons that start in locked states and unlock with story progression. The Phone will be your first unlock to introduce the system and future unlocks will be unique to the bag <br> <br> + Wardrobe and UI Overhaul <br> • A massive overhaul of the UI to the game with a new Swatch Color System in the Wardrobe. Any items you buy in the Shop will be able to be color swapped in the Wardrobe <br> <br> + Dynamic Music Queue and Phone System Overhaul <br> • The In Game Music player now tags music to respective eras. Your current song will naturally fade out and the next song in queue will track your current era (Past and Future shift the playlist with RNG, Present Era is neutral) <br> • Certain Story Beats will unlock a new song for the music player in a Hard Shift that will play a vinyl sound effect and automatically turn on the new song and permanently add it to your library <br> • The Phone shop will allow you to buy a custom phone case for both the music player widget and match a new in passage phone system used for text message chains. Toggle light/dark mode with the power button and Send the protagonists last message for an interactive touch <</texter>> <<textinput "Stop..." Quick Start links \ [[Begin Game|The Time Machine]] \ \ @@.time-jump;[[Skip Chapter]]@@\ </div>\ <i>"Transcriptions of Time"</i> is a story about the discovery of Time Travel where you will transition eras with your new device that starts unfolding into unforeseen consequences. It blends many different genres : At its heart the story is a character driven cozy slice of life that focuses on the player character and their best friend Matt on their time travel adventures. Underneath all the subtext spins a mystery psychological thriller, that integrates all the mechanics of the players transformations from its foundation of Sci-fi and speculative historical fiction. The players transformation is intended as a slow burn to let the process breath as you start as a man and slowly transition to eventually become a woman. (Which is tracked by a visual slider under the paperdoll.) The overall story features a slow burn MtF feminization arc, complete with a dynamic paperdoll and UI system that adapts to your transformations. As the story takes you through transformations, the paperdoll and all clothing assets adapt to your new form, while the UI shifts dynamically depending how far along in the journey you are with specific skills based on the players current gender, and tracks money based on the current era. The game does not include a character creator, but you will be able to first choose your own name and highly customize your character throughout the game which opens up more and more as the story develops with a shops and wardrobe system. The pacing of the game shifts quite a bit too, from longer story beats with simple forks from your choices, to more intimate fast pace scenes so no two playthroughs will be exactly the same. Without too much spoilers, the story can only be understood completely on a second playthrough, so it's suggested to enjoy your first playthrough the way you'd react, and the game will have a whole other half of the story if you decide to play again and make the opposite decisions. The story is completely original, no passages or dialogue sequences were ever crafted using AI. The paperdoll system and clothing assets were all hand drawn in Photoshop. AI disclaimer : The game does however feature some AI elements : Some passages will begin with a text-to-speech narration of the first line of dialogue to set the mood and give a small voice to the characters. For early development, environmental and character photos that start the passages have been generated by Photoshop's AI generative fill, after some trials and errors I feel the art style has been locked down pretty well, but would be open to replacing the images with artist creations or self made drawings if the community desires for future updates. Google's Gemini was used to proofread Javascript and CSS for any syntax errors or pinpointing bugs in the code. Some in-game elements/logos have placeholder emojis, as a lower priority change to come over time. Any historical characters and settings have undergone creative liberties to be ficitionlized during the story. [[Begin Game|The Time Machine]] <<me>> "Can't I just go to a bar?" <</me>> <<Matt>> "Dude, prohibition, remember" <</Matt>> <<Tommy>> "That's right, some bozo thought alcohol was too dangerous, and some other bozos agreed and they call me a criminal. So what will it be kid?"<</Tommy>> (Hand your credit card) <<Tommy>> "That's some strange ID you got their kid. Come back when you find some cash" <</Tommy>> (Change the past era cashbox from Credit card to Past era (Cash)) Passage LINKS <<link "Dev Test Scene">><<set $previousPassage to passage()>><<goto "Dev Test Scene">><</link>> <<link "Bathroom">><<set $previousPassage to passage()>><<goto "Bathroom">><</link>> <<link "Wardrobe">><<set $previousPassage to "The Time Machine">><<goto "Wardrobe">><</link>> <<link "Just in Case">><<set $previousPassage to "The Time Machine">><<goto "Just in Case">><</link>> <<link "Bleecker Basics">><<set $previousPassage to "The Time Machine">><<goto "Bleecker Basics">><</link>><<nobr>> <div class="image-container"> <img src="images/1926-Gano-Living-Room-Anime.png" class="story-image" alt="Living Room Past Environment"> </div> <</nobr>> \ As you and Matt reach the ground floor, you immediately notice the difference. The space spans a good 14 feet high before you see the ceiling embrodied in a golden decadent floral tile pattern. Where your building had been sub-sectioned off for different neighbors, the space is wide open, housing furniture even more antique than your Grandmother's table you've been using in your lab. You both naturally pause to take it all in, just as a man sitting in his chair sipping a brandy begins to take his eyes off from the book he was reading to look your way. <<Gano>> "My Word, who might you two men be? And why are you sneaking through my home dressed like.. well I don't know precisely, Has Julia arranged for your arrival?" <</Gano>> There's no going back now, you both have been immediately spotted dead-to-rights. Your only options now are to pretend to know who Julia might be or explain how you've traveled an entire century back in time, and you're actually in your <i>own</i> building on the way to your apartment upstairs. As you both freeze up, puzzled what to do next, you hear the clacking of heels over the wood floors and another voice chimes in. <<Julia>> "You called dear?" <</Julia>> She quickly spots you and Matt as the man replies. <<Gano>> "Ah, hello my love. Normally the pulses match with your heart beat, and part of it does, but another light is vibrating in a completely seperate measure that feels more disconnected. <<me>> "What is it now?" <</me>> You let out with a slight frustation. <<me>> "The Phase gun, it feels .. different." <</me>> The other version of you comments. <<Matt>> "What do you mean differen---?" <</Matt>> The other two Matts ask in unison. Before they can complete their sentence, the radiation of the blue light and the vibrations ascend violently stronger until there's a flash. <<Matt>> "..different?" <</Matt>> One Matt finishes. As the flash fades away, the other versions of yourselves vanished. And you only see yourself and the Matt in his pajamas left. The Phase Gun has settled down completely. You both stand quiet after watching the collapse. Until Matt makes the first word. <<Matt>> "This day really couldn't have been any stranger." <</Matt>> <<me>> "Just.. glad we're safe." <</me>> 'For now' you add only in your thoughts. <<Matt>> "Well we never found that coffee mug $playerName, so I'd say we'll need to go out to a cafe tomorrow to talk." <</Matt>> <<me>> "Yeah.. sounds like a plan. class="story-image" alt="Transcriptions of Time Logo"> </div> <</nobr>>\ <div class="choice-box"> Thank you so much for playing the very first public release of Transcriptions of Time! Hope you had fun, and if you haven't already, there's still lots more to see if you change your first time jump. The game will continue from here in the future release of Chapter 1 (and more chapters down the line). </div> <h3> What's coming next? </h3> We'll update the Game Description on the itch.io page with a Patreon link to open up early access and follow up a couple of weeks later with a free Public Release after giving any new supporters their first look. Many systems in the code have already been built in this version (1.0.0) that haven't been touched yet from the story. The entities transformations have more options than what the prologue let you change, but really want to pace these out well over the span of the game to give each phase a good heartbeat. There's some lingering elements in the UI that you may have noticied haven't really been touched. The hygeine skill goes up with a shower, but it doesn't currently go down or have any affect on the game. If the prologue changes much in future updates, that'd probably be where it'd start. Many of the skill in general are what will be slowly introduced with Chapter 1, not wanting to overwhelm the player with too much at once. The paperdoll system will be opening up a lot more in future chapters with Shop systems that will play similar to the Wardrobe. Allowing players to equip and buy new clothes and various in-game items (with in-game cash, not microtransactions!) There are many ideas for how the story will expand, but no spoilers! The important thing is that the foundation has been built to add on top of. Most of the work going forward will be involved in writing and making more clothing assets. And for coding, only have some minor adjustments that are being considered with future content, but nothing major to drag the time away from what players will want more of (the story) If you were a fan of the game or had any game breaking bugs that hurt your experience, please leave a comment. This is a passion project that is intended to go much further! All feedback is welcome. Just for a little fun, here's a link to the wardrobe before saying good bye. <<link "Wardrobe">><<set $previousPassage to "The Chronology of Echoes">><<goto "Wardrobe">><</link>> <div class="custom-naming-box" style="text-align: center;"> <<button "End of Content" "The Time Machine">><</button>> </div><<set $hasMap to true>>\ <<set $pendingBagItem to "City Map">>\ <<run UI.update()>>\ <<set $mattInParty to true>>\ <<nobr>> <div class="image-container"> <img src="images/2026-Landlord.png" class="story-image" alt="Landlord"> </div> <</nobr>>\ After opening the door, you see Matt cowering in the Kitchen area while your landlord is fuming. Your landlord is a pretty typical suit, you usually only interact just to pay rent. He's a 'time is money' type of guy, so when you see him standing right here inside your apartment, you know it's serious. <<Landlord>> "Do you have any idea how many of your neighbors complained to me! Just what was that commotion last night?" <</Landlord>> Matt acknowledes you with a glance and nod, his posture slightly more at ease at the sight of your appearance. Then he turns back to the active discussion. <<Matt>> "I told you, just some mixup with our science homework, it's all cleaned up, I swear!" <</Matt>> The landlord paces back and forth while he forms his next words. <<Landlord>> "I've been so forgiving, even freely let you two set up your equipment in the basement, exactly for instances like this to never occur!" <</Landlord>> The landlord starts rubbing his fingers together in that universal gesture that you already know his next thought is about money. <<Landlord>> "I think it's time we rethink our arrangement." <</Landlord>> Both you and Matt let out an audible gulp. Money's already pretty thin as it is. And you were saving up all season to have a good time when your sister arrives later this week. <<Matt>> "Please sir, it was all just a fluke." <</Matt>> Matt pleas, but it's of no use. You can tell your landlord's mind is essentially a ticking calculator right now, crossing the decimals and carrying over the one before he continues. <<Landlord>> "I'm willing to be fair. Let's call it a deposit. I need $250 up front. From both of you" <</Landlord>> <<me>> "What!? <</me>> You groan. <<Landlord>> "uh-uh-uh, let me finish. You make it until your next rent payment without any more... mishaps.." <</Landlord>> <<if $faceOverlayScore eq 2 || $nailsScore eq 1>> The landlord looks at you suspiciously, focusing on your new colorful and feminine appearance a bit taken back. <<else>>\ The landlord locks eyes with you and pauses for a moment. <</if>>\ <<Landlord>> "and it'll be deducted from your next payment. But should there be any more problems, you can consider your deposit gone." <</Landlord>> He starts heading for the door, not interested in any type of debate or response. Matt still doesn't give up <<Matt>> "But -" <</Matt>> But the door slams shut. <<Matt>> "What a dick." <</Matt>> Matt quickly stands up to run towards the apartment door, but he stops going further when he sees the Landord's gone and it would end up becoming a futile chase. You've never seen your landlord this upset before! He was even nice to you in the past when he knew you were too busy studying to get into any trouble. Matt's now got his back on the now closed door, slumping in worry. So for once, its you who tries to lighten up <i>his</i> mood. <<me>> "Hey, coffee's on me remember?" <</me>> You reach your arm out to help Matt off the ground. <<Matt>> "Thanks $playerName, I could really go for a cup before class." <</Matt>> Matt grabs his shoes, getting ready to head outside. <<if $faceOverlayScore eq 2 || $nailsScore eq 1>><<Matt>> "I'm uh.. not judging or anything, but you planning on going out like that?" <</Matt>> Matt looks at you carrying the remnants of Zoey and Claire's dares. <<elseif $faceOverlayScore gte 3 || $nailsScore gte 2>><<Matt>> "I'm uh.. not judging or anything, but you planning on going out like that?" <</Matt>> Matt notices you used the vanity. <<else>>\ <<Matt>> "Let me just grab some things, meet you outside when you're ready." <</Matt>> <</if>>\ <div class="choice-box">\ (You now have access to the City Map inside your Bag that will allow you to explore your home at any time for access to rooms like your wardrobe, even more locations will unlock further in the game. You and Matt have finished bringing Emerald up to speed on all that has happened, the completed invention of the phase gun, your first two time jumps, and most recently, the great epiphany of Mrs. Satoshi's story. <<Sister>> "You really think you're turning into a girl?" <</Sister>> <<me>> "Look at me Em, all day people were treating me like I've been willingly going through some 'self discovery', not able to understand the truth of all that happened to change me in the first place. She divvies out small portions of matcha powder into ceramic bowls before gently pouring hot water, followed up by a zig zag motion of the whisk. <<Satoshi>> "In an old village near the hills of Kyoto there lived a young priest, Hiroki. He was only a few years older than yourself. Hiroki didn't believe in ghosts or anything supernatural, but he had heard the stories of a haunted temple. The trees were so tall, that even during the day, it could feel like night. Stories of people disappearing in the temple made it hard to find priests to work in the temple, but Hiroki was not afraid, he was excited to begin his work. When Hiroki arrived to the temple, he began to pray. " <</Satoshi>> Mrs. Satoshi finishes her preparations of the tea, turns the bowl twice and hands it your way. <<Satoshi>> "His family decided to visit later that same day to share some gifts and food, but when they arrived, Hiroki could not be found. His parents searched everywhere, but all they could find were a pair of his straw sandals resting below a pear tree in the gardens." <</Satoshi>> She waits as you take a small sip from your tea and then takes her own before continuing. <<Satoshi>> "Terrified for their son, the family returned to the village to find help. Many people had warned Hiroki not to go the haunted temple, but still, they gathered with the family to try and help find him. As they walked up the mountain pass, the wind started growing louder until it stopped. The villagers walked past the garden to see the sandals are gone. Though inside they found him. Hiroki saw his family, so he came out of the temple, carrying a pale expression, to greet all the villagers." <</Satoshi>> <<Satoshi>> "But.." <</Satoshi>> She lingers and leans forward, her expression softening with a mix of academic curiosity and deep empathy. <<Satoshi>> "..Hiroki looked different. His features became much softer. When his family asked what was wrong, his account sounded just like yours $playerName. During his prayer, Hiroki had been taken away from the world. He didn't see anything or anyone. Only a voice spoke to him." <</Satoshi>> The earthy scent of the matcha tea breathes into you, it feels grounding in contrast to the spooky tale shared by your counselor. <<me>> "So what happened to Hiroki? What did the voice say?" <</me>> <<Satoshi>> "The villagers and his family begged Hiroki to return home. Hiroki otherwise, he wanted to know more, so continued to pray in the temple, searching for the voice again and again. When he was successful, each encounter came with a price, changing him more and more. "<</Satoshi>> Hiroki's story begins to bring into question your own journey with the entity. Do you even want to find it again? <<Satoshi>>"The family still lived in the nearby village, where one day a strange woman came to visit. She spoke of the same voice in the temple the same way Hiroki did, but even stranger, she spoke of childhood memories of the family. The family recognized all her stories, learning that their son had transformed into a daughter. The mysterious voice was never heard from again." <</Satoshi>> The story sends some chills down your neck, you never expected your school counselor to relate to your experiences with the entity. Yet, her story sounded like the exact same experience. <<me>> "Wow, I'm at a loss for words. Do you think that's what happened to me?" <</me>> She gently nods, <<Satoshi>> "In Japanese folklore, $playerName, there are many old myths about the Kamikakushi similar to your account." <</Satoshi>> <<me>> "What does Kamikakushi mean?" <</me>> Mrs. Satoshi starts writing with a calligraphy brush. <<Satoshi>> "In kanji, the character '神' is for '(かみ)<i>Kami</i>' which means god or spirit." <</Satoshi>> She continues drawing. <<Satoshi>> "’隠し' is '(かくし)<i>kakushi</i>' that means hidden. So when put together, the idea becomes 'hidden by the gods' or more common, the 'Spirited Away'. It describes a phenomenon where a traveler steps across an invisible threshold, often at twilight, and finds themselves trapped in a space where the normal rules of the world break down." <</Satoshi>> Watching your counselor sit down to share stories and tea while writing so elegantly in Japanese has turned into a fascinating experience that has made you feel completely comfortable with Mrs. Satoshi. You're glad that she's sharing this moment with you instead of treating your confession as the ravings of a mad man. <<Satoshi>> "Many people that disappeared never came back, but those who did return.. were different from the person left, like Hiroki." <</Satoshi>> She offers a reassuring, gentle smile, though the weight of her words hangs heavily in the quiet office. <<Satoshi>> "You don't have to go through this alone $playerName. Please visit me if you have any more experiences or changes you need to talk about." <</Satoshi>> <<me>> "Thank you Mrs. Satoshi. Will I be in trouble for missing class today?" <</me>> <<Satoshi>> "As I said before, you're not in trouble $playerName. I will speak with Professor Bennet about where you were today. You may take the rest of today off. And I think it would be best if you come to visit every Monday after class so we may speak more." <</Satoshi>> Mrs. Satoshi casually sets the recurring appointment and opens the door to allow you to leave early from school. As you reach the fountain a young man, roughly your age, gives a warm smile, nesting his hands in his pockets. <<Tommy>> "Out of towners?" <</Tommy>> You and Matt exchange eye contact before proceeding. <<me>> "Yeah, something like that." <</me>> <<Tommy>> "Something like that.." <</Tommy>><<if $layer11_tops.includes("-02-") or $layer10_bottoms.includes("-02-")>>\ He eyes you down, looking at you wearing Women's clothing. <<Tommy>> "Lookin' sharp for a stage play."<</Tommy>> He smirks, <<Tommy>> "Should I be looking for your name on the bill down at the Provincetown Playhouse?" <</Tommy>> <<Matt>> "The playhouse?" <</Matt>> <<Tommy>> "Forget about it, the name's Tommy Quinn." <</Tommy>> He reaches out his hand, for an introduction. \ <<else>>\ He eyes you down, looking at your casual attire. <<Tommy>> "Lose your luggage on the train? Or is walking around half dressed the new style?" <</Tommy>> <<Matt>> "Half dressed??" <</Matt>> <<Tommy>> "Forget about it, the name's Tommy Quinn." <</Tommy>> He reaches out his hand, for an introduction. <</if>>\ <<me>> "$playerName Hayes" <</me>> <<Matt>> "Matthew McGinley" <</Matt>> You and Matt both make your quick introductions, but Matt's seems to put a shine to Tommy's eyes. <<Tommy>> "A McGinley, huh? You picked the right neighborhood." <</Tommy>> Tommy flicks open a silver pocket watch, catches the time with a quick squint, and tucks it back into his trousers. <<Tommy>> "If you're done sightseeing, come on. I'll show you where the actual city is." <</Tommy>> (You have time for two activities) <<elseif $conversationCount eq 1>>\ <<if $visitedJazzClub is true>>\ <<Tommy>> "You boys took to Vinny's like old regulars. Might have to bring you back down there." <</Tommy>> <<elseif $visitedMarket is true>>\ <<Tommy>>"I'm not sure what was more fun, rolling bones, or dodging flatfeet."<</Tommy>> Tommy says hunched over, searching for breath between laughs. <<elseif $visitedBilliard is true>>\ <<if $winPool is true>>\ <<Tommy>> ""Still don't know how you snuck that eight ball in. I'll be watching your hands next time." <</Tommy>> <<elseif $winPool is false>>\ <<Tommy>> "Don't feel too bad about the table, kid. House always wins." <</Tommy>> Tommy comments on the game of billiards. <<else>>\ <<Tommy>> "Thought you fell asleep standing up with that pool stick" <</Tommy>> Tommy teases you for not talking the final shot at the tables. <</if>>\ <<elseif $visitedCoffee is true>>\ <<Tommy>> "Quiet little joint, that. Beats pounding the pavement on an empty stomach, even if that fellow with the pencil was a few cards shy of a full deck. Good coffee, though." <</Tommy>> <</if>>\ <<Tommy>> "What next boys?" <</Tommy>> (You have time for one more activity) <<elseif $conversationCount eq 2>>\ <<addRel "Matt" 10>>\ <<addRel "Tommy" 10>>\ The afternoon has begun to shift into the early evening with the moon replacing the sun. The breeze falling colder by the minute. <<Tommy>> "Well boys, my shift down at the docks starts before the sun has any business showing its face. Look out for yourselves out there, it was a pleasure." <</Tommy>> <<me>> "Night Tommy!" <</me>> You say waving him off. Your new vintage friend pops his collar with a friendly head nod and wave, leaving you and Matt near Washington Square Arch to yourselves. <<Matt>> "What an adventure." <</Matt>> Matt's more than happy with your decisions. <<me>> "I have to admit, that was a healthy distraction. Tommy treated us like old friends, felt like I was just in the moment not worried about anything." <</me>> <<Matt>> "Yeah, I don't even want to go back. Though it'd be cool if Em popped in right now." <</Matt>> You stare down thinking about the Phase Gun. If only it were that easy to just pop back and forth, without a visit to the entity. <<me>> "Well, we could always check in with our family of the past." <</me>> You tilt your head in direction towards Julie and Gano's mansion. <<Matt>> "We have to!" <</Matt>> (It's too late for any more activities) <</if>>\ <div class="choice-box">\ <<if $visitedJazzClub>>\ <span style="color: gray; text-decoration: line-through;">Get Coffee</span> <<elseif $conversationCount gte 2>> <span style="color: gray;">Get Coffee</span> <<else>>\ [[Get Coffee|Coffee]]\ <</if>>\ </div>\ \ <<if $conversationCount gte 2>>\ <br><br>[[Check on Julie and Gano][$conversationCount to 0]] <</if>><<set $sisterInParty to false>>\ <<addHygiene "-1">>\ <<nobr>> <div class="image-container"> <img src="images/2126-Washington-Square-Park.png" class="story-image" alt="2126 Washington Square Park at Sunset"> </div> <</nobr>>\<<if not $visitedJazzClub>>\ <<set $visitedJazzClub to true>>\ <<set $conversationCount += 1>>\ <<addMoney 20>>\ <<endif>>\ <<set $tempSave to { top: $layer11_tops, bottom: $layer10_bottoms, bb: $layer10b_bottoms }>>\ <<if $layer3_upperBody is "images/Body-UpperBody-Mid-Waist.png">>\ <<set $layer11_tops = "images/Tops-01-Mid-Dress-Coat.png">>\ <<elseif $layer3_upperBody is "images/Body-UpperBody-Tapered.png">>\ <<set $layer11_tops = "images/Tops-01-Tapered-Dress-Coat.png">>\ <<else>>\ <<set $layer11_tops = "images/Tops-01-Masc-Dress-Coat.png">>\ <</if>>\ <<run playShopDoorBell()>>\ <<nobr>> <div class="image-container"> <img src="images/1928-Dry-Cleaners.png" class="story-image" alt="1926 Dry Cleaners"> </div> <</nobr>>\ Tommy casually opens a door to a dry cleaners, holding the door open with his back and signaling his hand for you to go in first. <<me>> "Here to pick up your coat?" <</me>> You ask confused. Tommy steps away from the door allowing it to close on its own. As he follows behind you, he answers you with a small chuckle attached to his response, <<Tommy>> "Me and half the town. Best slip into a coat yourself if you don't want every flatfoot in the district staring holes through you." <</Tommy>> You listen to Tommy and find a wool coat on one of the racks that looks to be about your size. It's long enough to push past your knees, but comfortably sits over the rest of your clothes. After putting on the jacket you check the fit and are lucky to find some cash in one of the pockets. Tommy notices right away and shares with you a satisfying smirk. <<Tommy>> "Lucky you." <</Tommy>> Matt's now also found his disguise in a big black coat and trilby hat. <<Matt>> "Nice $playerName!" <</Matt>> He looks through his pockets too, hoping to share some of your luck. After a few moments of checking each pocket, Matt takes out a metal container. <<Matt>> "A flask!" <</Matt>> He opens the lid to take a swig. <<Tommy>> "You boys are alright. Come on, the real show's down the stairs." <</Tommy>> Tommy pushes a section of hangers to the side revealing a hidden doorframe that is flush with the wall. He proceeds with a knock, which is very soon followed by a response from the other side. <<NPCP>> "Password?" <</NPCP>> <<Tommy>> "Need a coat pressing, for Vinny" <</Tommy>> The man on the otherside makes some affirmative grunts, then the hidden frame is pushed out of the dry cleaner's wall, revealing the secret door that is pushed inwards to welcome you in. [[Speakeasy]]<<if not $visitedMarket>>\ <<set $visitedMarket to true>>\ <<set $conversationCount += 1>>\ <<addMoney 5>>\ <<endif>>\ <<nobr>> <div class="image-container"> <img src="images/1926-Street-Market.png" class="story-image" alt="1926 Street Market with Tommy at Sunset"> </div> <</nobr>>\ A nearby street market draws your attention. Shop vendors and crowds of people intermingle while the sound of horse cleats smacking against cobblestone tick tack across the street. The air is filled with the smell of warm roasted chestnuts, baked breads, and various comforting food. Small groups of musicians line the streets playing their instruments with their hats on the ground to collect tips. Everywhere you look feels interesting and full with life. <<Tommy>> "Heart of the city right here. You can buy anything from a hot potato to a loaded pair of dice if you know who to ask. Come on, let's see what the boys are running down the alley." <</Tommy>> Tommy sets the pace, leading the way between the crowded streets. You see the classic newsboys trying to sell today's paper, rows of cheese wheels, and vendors trading fruit. You and Matt bob your head in every direction checking the scene, but Tommy on the other hand is focused, until he takes you to a small alleyway. <<Danny>> "Tommy!" <</Danny>> A few guys are crouched down throwing dice, smoking on hand rolled cigarettes, and placing wagers. <<Red>> "About time you showed up, Quinn. Ready to lighten that bankroll?" <</Red>> One of the other guys asks Tommy. <<Tommy>> "Look alive, fellas. Brought a couple of greenhorns to see how a real game’s run. Scoot over and give 'em some elbow room. Show our new friends how the other half lives." <</Tommy>> Tommy slips you $5 between his knuckles and a pat on the back. The two friends start playfully shoving each other, clearing their cash off the ground, and tossing a set of dice your way. <<Red>> "Best I give the spots a rest, Danny's got a hot hand." <</Red>> Danny smirks and winks at his introduction. <<Danny>> "Simple enough, gents. Under and Overs. Lay your scratch down on the tarp. Bet it under, over, or right on the fat seven." <</Danny>> With that, the dice are in your hands ready to play. <<streetDice>> While you're busy at your turn throwing dice, Danny and the other guys start rolling more tobacco. When they get one perfected they turn to you. <<Red>> "Smoke?" <</Red>> <div class="choice-box">\ <span id="cigarette-choice">\ <<link "Smoke">> <<run window.VFX.smoke()>>\ <<set $hasCigarette = true>>\ <<replace "#cigarette-choice">>You take a drag from the cigarette and pass it back.<</replace>>\ <</link>> | \ <<link "Decline">>\ <<set $hasCigarette = false>>\ <<replace "#cigarette-choice">>You decline. <<Red>>"More for the chimney." <</Red>> He jokes, taking a drag for himself. <</replace>>\ <</link>>\ </span>\ </div>\ Tommy comes in between you and Matt, extending his arms behind each of your backs. <<Tommy>> "Reckon you saw enough of these two bit grifters. Grab your scratch, if you've got any left, and let's get back to the stalls."<</Tommy>> The other boys take a break enjoying their smoke as they wave you off. Tommy's about to escort you from the alley back to the market stalls, when suddenly, you see a cop gauge the scene. A heavy beam of a flashlight cuts through the dusk, sweeping across the brick wall before locking onto the tarp. <<Cop>> "Alright, break it up. What’s going on back here?" <</Cop>> Danny immediately snuffs his cigarette against the brick with a flick of his thumb, while Red smoothly kicks the dice under an old crate. Tommy doesn't panic. He steps forward just enough to put himself between you and the uniform, flashing a wide, utterly harmless grin. <<Tommy>> "Evening, Officer. Just showing my out of town cousins the shortcut back to the square. Streets are a maze at this hour." <</Tommy>> <<Cop>> "Save it. Step away from the crates, all of you." <</Cop>> <<Tommy>> "Let's blow this clambake, boys. Move!" <</Tommy>> Tommy grabs you and Matt by the shoulders, pivoting you hard into a narrow side gap between the crates, knocking one down for a makeshift obstacle. You scramble after him and back out into the bustling safety of the market crowd, heart hammering against your ribs. <<me>> "That was a close one." <</me>> You let out between breathes. <<Tommy>> "Nothing like a flatfoot with a flashlight to clear the air. Let's keep moving before he decides to check our pockets." <</Tommy>> <<Matt>> "We can see the markets another time, let's do something else." <</Matt>> Matt suggests. The three of you head back to the park to debrief. [[Return to Park|Washington Square Past]]<<if not $visitedBilliard>>\ <<set $visitedBilliard to true>>\ <<set $conversationCount += 1>>\ <<run playShopDoorBell()>>\ <<endif>>\ <<nobr>> <div class="image-container"> <img src="images/1926-Billiards.png" class="story-image" alt="Billiards Parlor with Tommy"> </div> <</nobr>>\ Heavy curtains wash out the afternoon sun inside the dimly lit billiards parlor. The corners of the room hide behind hazy layers of smoke drifting throughout the atmosphere. Colliding pool balls clatter over the cascading static of an old time radio's upbeat jazz number. Tommy lifts a few pool sticks off the wall to hand one over to you and Matt. <<Tommy>> "Get a feel for the felt, then we’ll rack 'em up for a real game." <</Tommy>> Tommy casually suggests, standing off to the side, lighting up a smoke of his own. <<billiardsMiniGame>> You take a few practice shots, then look towards Tommy ready to begin, <<me>> "Think we've got the hang of it. Ready for a match?" <</me>> Tommy nods, changing his posture more upright as he grabs his pool stick. <<Tommy>> "So, who's stepping up to the break?" <</Tommy>> <div class="choice-box">\ <span id="turn-choice">\ <<link "Go first">> <<run window.playCueStrike('heavy')>>\ <<run window.playPocketSink()>>\ <<replace "#turn-choice">>Matt pats your shoulder for some encouragement and you take your shot.<</replace>>\ <</link>> | \ <<link "Let Tommy play first">>\ <<run window.playCueStrike('heavy')>>\ <<run window.playPocketSink()>>\ <<replace "#turn-choice">><<Tommy>> "I'll gladly break the ice." <</Tommy>> Tommy says lining up his shot. <</replace>>\ <</link>>\ </span>\ </div>\ The triangle of colored pool balls break with a loud crack, spinning off in various directions across the felt. Two balls already drop neatly into the pockets. <<Tommy>> "Well look at that. Take your pick, stripes or solids?" <</Tommy>> <div class="choice-box">\ <span id="ball-choice">\ <<link "Stripes">>\ <<set $isStripes = true>> <<run window.playCueStrike('heavy')>>\ <<replace "#ball-choice">><<Matt>>"Nice choice."<</Matt>> Matt's satisfied to follow your choice and takes his next turn aiming fror the stripes. <</replace>>\ <</link>> | \ <<link "Solids">>\ <<set $isStripes = false>> <<run window.playCueStrike('heavy')>>\ <<replace "#ball-choice">><<Matt>>"Nice Choice."<</Matt>> Matt's satisfied to follow your choice and takes his next turn aiming fror the solids. <</replace>>\ <</link>>\ </span>\ </div>\ Matt and you are making a pretty good team and it's still anyone's game. After a few exchanges of the lead, there are now only one stripe and solid left on the table in addition to the eight ball, but your next shot is trapped. If you aimed straight you could maybe try to sabotage Tommy's next shot. Or you could try to bank the cue ball to the right to hit your ball. <div class="choice-box">\ <span id="ball-choice2">\ <<link "Sabotage">>\ <<run window.playPocketSink()>>\ <<replace "#ball-choice2">>If you can't make your shot, you figure it's best to put Tommy in a similar position on his next shot. You aim straight for his next target, but instead of sabotaging him, it lands right into the left pocket leaving him only the eight ball left!<</replace>>\ <</link>> | \ <<link "Bank Shot">>\ <<run window.playRailBounce()>>\ <<replace "#ball-choice2">>You decide it's best to play fair, so you place your eye low to the table, mapping the trajectory of the ball in your minds eye. It's just geometry and physics you remind yourself. You take the shot and it's clean! The cue ball bounces off the rail and cleanly places the ball right next to the pocket for Matt's next turn. <</replace>>\ <</link>>\ </span>\ </div>\ <<Tommy>> "Very interesting." <</Tommy>> Tommy comments, making his next move carefully. The game's getting down to the wire now and it's about to all come down to the eight ball. Tommy doesn't quite make the shot, leaving both the cue and eight ball near the center of the table. <<Tommy>> "Alright, call your pocket." <</Tommy>> <div class="choice-box">\ <span id="ball8-choice">\ <<link "Left Pocket">>\ <<set $winPool = false>> <<run window.playCueStrike('heavy')>>\ <<replace "#ball8-choice">><<me>>"Left pocket" <</me>> You declare with a calm, composed confidence. You hit the cue ball clean and with accuracy, but the power is just a bit short, basically handing the win over to Tommy. <</replace>>\ <</link>> | \ <<link "Right Pocket">>\ <<set $winPool = true>> <<run window.playPocketSink()>>\ <<replace "#ball8-choice">><<me>>"Right pocket" <</me>> You declare with a calm, composed confidence. The shot is made with respectable strength and .. IT'S IN! You've won the game! You and Matt cheer while Tommy starts a slow clap of appreciation for a good game. <</replace>>\ <</link>>\ </span>\ </div>\ <<Tommy>> "Close match. Next time we run tables, let's put a little folding money on the game." <</Tommy>> Tommy holds out his hand to take your pool stick to return them to the wall. <<Matt>> "That was a great idea, we need to play this again sometime $playerName, me vs you." <</Matt>> Matt's beaming smile says it all. You both had a great time. [[Return to Park|Washington Square Past]]<<if not $visitedCoffee>>\ <<set $visitedCoffee to true>>\ <<set $conversationCount += 1>>\ <<run playShopDoorBell()>>\ <<set $metEstlin = true>>\ <<endif>>\ <<nobr>> <div class="image-container"> <img src="images/1926-Coffeehouse.png" class="story-image" alt="1926 Coffeehouse"> </div> <</nobr>>\ The unmistakable smell of roasted coffee already feels like home as you enter a vintage coffeehouse. <<if $vanillaBean is true>> It's not too different from the Vanilla Bean really. The patrons are dressed more nicely on average, but not too out of the ordinary for many New Yorkers. <<elseif $vanillaBean is false>> It's not nearly as upscale as your visit to the Oynx & Oat you went to earlier in the day. The patrons are dressed just as sophisticated, but the furniture is much more handcrafted and ordinary. <</if>> You notice a strange man in the corner, scribbiling on his napkin as he looks up to you, and back down towards his napkin, but you don't give it much mind as you look towards the menu. If only if it were as easy as this in your time, the handwritten card of options is sparse, listing only a few choices from turkish coffee, dark drip, or a pot of tea. Fortunately, you enjoy your black coffee just fine. <<Tommy>> "I'll take care of us $playerName, don't you worry about it." <</Tommy>> Tommy sets his hat down on the table, walking up to the counter. You and Matt sit yourselves down while Matt comments on the parallel of visiting a coffee shop again with you in the same day. <<Matt>> "It's like we never left." <</Matt>> He jokes. <<me>> "So what do you think of Tommy?" <</me>> You inquire, taking advantage of the first private moment to yourselves since his introduction. <<if $visitedJazzClub is true>>\ <<Matt>> "What a character, wonder what's in that underground speakeasy back in our time." <</Matt>> Matt pulls out the flask from his pocket with a mischievous smile. <<Matt>> "Thinking of 'irishing up' my coffee if you want some." <</Matt>> <<elseif $visitedMarket is true>>\ <<Matt>>"He might not be the best influence, but I have to admit the markets felt like a scene right out of a movie."<</Matt>> <<elseif $visitedBilliard is true>>\ <<Matt>>"Well he's a real good pool player, made me feel right at home, probably like you do in this coffee shop."<</Matt>> Matt jokes. <<else>>\ <<Matt>>"Not a lot to base anything on, but it's hard to say something bad about a fellow irishman."<</Matt>> <</if>>\ As you and Matt are talking, your eyes drift back to the corner where you notice the strange man still taking peeks your way and writing on his napkin. It was weird when you entered, but now his observation is making you feel wildly out of place. Tommy returns with a few cups of coffee and notices your strange facial expression instantly, almost making a scene as he drops the coffees down on the table and looks towards the strange man. <<Tommy>> "Something you want to say to my friend here, pal?" <</Tommy>> <<Estlin>>"hi." <</Estlin>> His response slides off casual and deadpan, without even a flinch in his reaction. Tommy notices the man's pencil wavering over the napkin too, so he steps closer towards him to investigate. <<Tommy>> "What are you doing anyway?" <</Tommy>> <<Estlin>> "drawing." <</Estlin>> He slides the napkin across the table that Tommy is now standing over. <<Tommy>> "Well, ain't that a peach. Hey, $playerName, you're going to want to take a gander at this." <</Tommy>> The man holds out his arms to the side in a non-verbal queue as if to say he's fine for you all to come closer and look. You and Matt take the three coffees and move over to the table. Tommy is still looking at the napkin that now draws your attention too. A crude gesture drawing of Tommy in a defensive posture is brushed lightly into the paper, but a much more intricate caricature is next to it, that oddly resembles, well, you. <<me>> "Is that.. me?" <</me>> You ask, taking your eyes off the illustration to gauge the man's reaction. <<Estlin>> "Unmistakably. Though the paper lacks your specific brand of gravity." <</Estlin>> He issues his response without a hint of embarrassment or anxiety over his work. <<Tommy>> "He actually got your nose right. I'll give you that, pal." <</Tommy>> Tommy chuckles, shaking his head as he slides the napkin back across the wood table. <<Tommy>> "You're a real card, mister... what did you say your name was again?" <</Tommy>> <<Estlin>> "I didn't. But Estlin will do." <</Estlin>> He taps his pencil against the table. <<Estlin>> "It's yours if you'd like, first one's free." <</Estlin>> He begins to stand, removing his coat from the chair and making his way to the door. The three of you are still staring at the napkin like lost puppies. When Tommy removes his finger from the napkin Matt notices a new detail, <<Matt>> "Wait a second..." <</Matt>> Matt leans in close, squinting at the corner of the paper. <<Matt>> "Look at the signature. e.e. cummings." <</Matt>> <<Tommy>> "Who?" <</Tommy>> Tommy asks, wiping a drop of coffee off the table. <<me>> "Just... a local poet." <</me>> You say, exchanging a knowing look with Matt as you realize you just crossed paths with one of the literary giants of the century. Matt rushes to the front door to see where he went, but he's already faded away into the streets of New York, leaving you three to finish your coffees. [[Return to Park|Washington Square Past]]<<nobr>> <div class="image-container"> <img src="images/1926-Speakeasy.png" class="story-image" alt="1926 Speakeasy"> </div> <</nobr>>\ Jazz music flows from the room and Tommy guides you both downstairs to see a lively bar, filled to the brim with people. A bartender acknowledges the three of you right away while serving other customers with a head nod, he seems to know Tommy by name, <<Bartender>> "New friends, Tommy?" <</Bartender>> <<Tommy>> "Aye, showing them the real McCoy." <</Tommy>> The Bartender starts filling up a few glasses. <<Bartender>> "First one's on the house." <</Bartender>> He slides the three glasses your way and returns to checking on other customers. <div class="choice-box">\ <span id="drink-choice">\ <<link "Drink">>\ <<run window.VFX.drink()>>\ <<set $hasDrink = true>>\ <<replace "#drink-choice">> Tommy dings his glass next to yours. <<Tommy>> "Cheers fellas." <</Tommy>><</replace>>\ <</link>> | \ <<link "Politely decline">>\ <<set $hasDrink = false>>\ <<replace "#drink-choice">> Tommy slides your glass his way next to his own. <<Tommy>> "Just here for the scenery, huh?" <</Tommy>><</replace>>\ <</link>>\ </span>\ </div>\ To your immediate left is a real life flapper, presumably on a date with her man, the scene feels like you've stepped into a movie. Perhaps, your stare became a bit intense for her as she notices you looking towards her causing her to blush. <<Flapper>> "Careful $miss. Keep staring like that and your eyes'll get stuck." <</Flapper>> She lets out with a nervous laugh. <<me>> "Sorry ma'am, was just thinking is all" <</me>> You try your best to fit in, not quite sure how people speak in this time. <<Flapper>> "Ma'am? So polite. Are you trying to court my Grandmere? Most fellows in here only find their manners when they're trying to shake you down for a watch. So what's a couple of stiffs like you hiding under those funeral coats anyway?" <</Flapper>> Tommy steps in before things escalate too far. <<Tommy>> "What my friend meant to say is you're looking mighty fine, hun, but $she don't get out much. Name's Tommy, and this here is $playerName. We ain't looking to cause trouble, just trying to wet our whistles." <</Tommy>> The flapper’s eyes flick from Tommy’s confident grin back to you, a corner of her mouth ticking upward in an amused smirk as she takes in the heavy wool coats. <<Flapper>> "Is that right? Well, your friend has a mighty peculiar way of scoping out a joint." <</Flapper>> She casts a quick, sideways glance down the bar toward where her companion is deep in conversation with a bartender, lowering her voice just enough to bridge the gap between your stools. <<Flapper>> "He's been talking about racehorses for twenty minutes straight, so a little company wouldn't kill me. Buy a girl a ginger ale and I might let you sit." <</Flapper>> Right on cue the bartender heads your way to check in, the flapper's companion returns as she gives you a half hand wave before returning to her conversation. Seeing Tommy's drink already empty, the bartender takes the empty glasses before he asks if the night's planning to continue, <<Bartender>> "Another round?" <</Bartender>> <<if $hasDrink is false>> <<Tommy>> "Well, look at that. I'm fixed up." <</Tommy>> Tommy glances down at the extra glass he got from you, and slaps a coin on the table to show appreciation." <<else>> <<Tommy>> "I'm never one to turn down a refill." <</Tommy>> <</if>> <div class="choice-box">\ <span id="drink-choice2">\ <<link "Buy Drink $1">>\ <<run window.VFX.drink()>>\ <<addMoney -1>>\ <<set $hasDrink = true>>\ <<replace "#drink-choice2">> Tommy dings his glass next to yours. <<Tommy>> "Bottoms up!" <</Tommy>><</replace>>\ <</link>> | \ </span>\ </div>\ Tommy nearly finishes his drink in one large gulp, encouraging you to do the same. <<Tommy>> "Well don't just stand there, let's make tracks." <</Tommy>> The three of you head back up the stairs, placing your coats back on a hanger before leaving the 'dry cleaners'. [[Return to Park|Washington Square Past][$layer11_tops = $tempSave.top, $layer10_bottoms = $tempSave.bottom, $layer10b_bottoms = $tempSave.bb]]<<unlockLocation "VogueBoutique" "past">>\ <<set $currentShopId to "Vogue_Boutique">>\ <<set $currentShopPassage to passage()>>\ <<ShopClothingGrid>>\ <<link "Leave Shop">> <<if window.canLeaveShop()>> <<goto $previousPassage>> <</if>> <</link>><<set $visitedVogue = $visitedVogue || false>>\ <<if !$butlerStop>>\ <<set $butlerStop = true>>\ <<addMoney 80>>\ <<set $initialInventoryCount to $ownedTops.length + $ownedBottoms.length + $ownedUndergarments.length + $ownedShoes.length + $ownedAccessories.length>>\ <</if>>\ <<nobr>> <div class="image-container"> <img src="images/1926-Mansion-Night-Butler.png" class="story-image" alt="1926 Pierre outside Washington Square North Mansion"> </div> <</nobr>>\ <<if $visitedVogue is true>>\ <<set $currentInventoryCount to $ownedTops.length + $ownedBottoms.length + $ownedUndergarments.length + $ownedShoes.length + $ownedAccessories.length>>\ \ <<if $currentInventoryCount gt $initialInventoryCount>>\ <<Butler>> "Ah, welcome back. You both look lovely this evening." <</Butler>> The butler politely issues out his hand towards the door to welcome you in. <<Butler>> "I do apologize for the inconvenience.
